title: Riglordsaga
overview:
Guided by the "legend" handed down in the land of Riglord, the door to Arthur and his companions' battle now opens...

Arthur, prince of the kingdom of Queensland, finds himself branded a rebel when his mother the queen falls under an evil lord's spell. With his companions he fights to win back his homeland and free its people.

In this tactical RPG, battles play out turn by turn on 3D grid battlefields, some with several levels. Move each party member and then attack, defend, cast spells or use items. Missions may ask you to rout the enemy, reach a goal or slip past foes. Characters learn new techniques through inspiration as they fight, and the techniques they favor shape the ones that come next. Gather a band of heroes, and switch the camera viewpoint freely during battle.

- 1 player
- Memory backup support

リグロードの地に伝わりし『伝説』に導かれ、アーサーたちの戦いの扉が今、開かれる…
